\begin{example} \end{example}[Nonhomogeneous wave equation for $n=1,3$] ↗ thm:wave-equation-nonhomogeneous-duhamel ↗ thm:wave-equation-dalembert-solution 1. ch2:2.4.2-ex-1\group Wave Equation

For $n=1$, zero initial data give \[ (43)\qquad u(x,t)=\frac12\int _0^t\int _{x-s}^{x+s}f(y,t-s)\, dy\, ds. \] For $n=3$, Kirchhoff's formula gives the retarded potential \[ (44)\qquad u(x,t)=\frac1{4\pi }\int _{B(x,t)} \frac{f(y,t-|y-x|)}{|y-x|}\, dy. \] \end{example}
